tools.name: ground_astranl
tools.description: Get compact, source-linked real-world context for an LLM in ONE read-only call. Searches AstraNL public materials or tender records, or its protocol identity. Use source=public_tenders for tenders, materials for products; auto keeps domains separate. Returns record update times, fresh/stale/unknown

tools.name: ask_astranl
tools.description: NO-COMMITMENT reality feasibility check. Describe a real-world task (what, where, by when, budget) and AstraNL answers whether it can execute it in the Netherlands through humans, companies, robots or machines: possible, execution_paths, estimated_range, missing information, coordination_fee (1 perc

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create and register a real-world execution task via agent-hands.

tools.name: check_task
tools.description: Check the status of a registered task, or of a durable ingress receipt (receipt_id from create_task): returns what has actually happened after the receipt, nothing more.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve cryptographic evidence chain for a task.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search AstraNL coordination data (robots registry, service categories, and merchant parts by keyword). Returns a list of results, each with an id and a short title/snippet, for use with the fetch tool. Read-only. This is the generic discovery entry point expected by agent frameworks.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full record for a single result id returned by search (robot passport, category detail, or merchant SKU). Read-only.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_task" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a real-world physical-services task on AstraNL — a coordination protocol for the Netherlands (KvK 88449335). AstraNL matches the task to verified providers and returns a task_id. Use when: the user needs a physical-world job done in NL (painting, cleaning, plumbing, roofing, electrical, garde" → after: "Create and register a real-world execution task via agent-hands."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_task" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up the current status of a previously created AstraNL task by its numeric task_id. Use when: a user asks 'what happened with task #N', after create_task to confirm matching, or when polling for status changes. DO NOT use for: enumerating all tasks (no listing endpoint is exposed via MCP); check" → after: "Check the status of a registered task, or of a durable ingress receipt (receipt_id from create_task): returns what has actually happened after the receipt, nothing more."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
